newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH ITI TO ENTER LUXEMBOURG BOURSE ON JAN 29.
newsitem.headline: POLISH ITI TO ENTER LUXEMBOURG BOURSE ON JAN 29.

text.p: ITI Holdings SA, a Luxembourg- based parent company of the Polish multi-media and snacks producer ITI Group will start trading on the Luxembourg bourse on Wednesday, deputy president of ITI Group said on Tuesday.
"Our firm is the first Polish company to enter the exchange in Luxembourg," Mariusz Walter told a news conference.

Deputy president Bruno Valsangiacomo, also present, said the firm would start early next year preparations to enter also the Warsaw Stock Exchange but said it had yet to decide whether it would issue new shares before Warsaw bourse entry.
"Our plan is to seek listing (in Warsaw) in 1998...we expect the legal procedures should start early in 1998 as they usually take six-nine months," he said.
ITI Group deals with advertising, theatrical and home video distribution, television broadcasting and snack food production.
ITI estimated its net profit flat at $3.3 million in 1996 and expected it to fall to $1.2 million in 1997, but to rebound to $5.3 million in 1998, $11.5 million in 1999 and $19.7 million in 2000.
Its sales were estimated to grow to $104 million this year from estimated $76.9 million and to top $201.2 million in 2000.
In 1995 the company had a net profit of $3.3 million on 67.8-million-zloty-sales.
